column3: The Hebrew names the third year without separately saying “of the drought”; BSB supplies that qualification.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew calls the residence a house; BSB specifies “the palace”.
The Hebrew names bread and water; BSB has “food and water”.
The Hebrew names horse and mule in the singular and watercourses alongside springs; BSB uses plural animals and “valley”.

The Hebrew repeats Ahab as speaker; BSB uses “he”.
